paragraphs.zh: Die erfindungsgemäßen Verbindungen der Formel (I) weisen eine ausgezeichnete herbizide Wirksamkeit gegen ein breites Spektrum wirtschaftlich wichtiger mono- und dikotyler Schadpflanzen auf. Auch schwer bekämpfbare perennierende Unkräuter, die aus Rhizomen, Wurzelstöcken oder anderen Dauerorganen austreiben, werden durch die Wirkstoffe gut erfaßt. Dabei ist es in der Regel unerheblich, ob die Substanzen im Vorsaat-, Vorauflauf- oder Nachauflaufverfahren ausgebracht werden. Im einzelnen seien beispielhaft einige Vertreter der mono- und dikotylen Unkrautflora genannt, die durch die erfindungsgemäßen Verbindungen kontrolliert
paragraphs.en: The compounds of the formula (I) according to the invention exhibit excellent herbicidal activity against a broad spectrum of economically important monocotyledonous and dicotyledonous harmful plants. Perennial weeds that are difficult to control and that shoot from rhizomes, rootstocks or other perennating organs are also well controlled by the active ingredients. In this it is generally immaterial whether the substances are applied by the pre-sowing, pre-emergence or post-emergence method. In detail, some representatives of the monocotyledonous and dicotyledonous weed flora that are controlled by the compounds according to the invention may be named by way of example
paragraphs.notes: The paragraph runs off the foot of the page in mid-sentence after 'kontrolliert' and continues on the following page; the English is left unterminated to match. Spelling is pre-1996 German orthography as printed: 'erfaßt' with eszett, 'Im einzelnen' with a lower-case e. Umlauts and eszett are transcribed as printed. A small stray ink dot sits above the word 'Wirkstoffe' on the fifth printed line; it is a scan artifact, not punctuation, and is not transcribed. This prose does not refer to Schema 4 above it; the two are unrelated pieces of the description that happen to share the page.

structures.core: 2-aroyl cyclic 1,3-dione drawn in its enol form, linked through a ketone carbonyl to a benzene ring. Ring members of the dione ring as drawn, going clockwise from the enol carbon at the top: C(OH) = C(aroyl) - C(=O) - Y - Z - a bracketed (CH2) unit written as '( )v' that closes the ring back onto the enol carbon. Y and Z are drawn as ring-member variable labels, adjacent to one another, with Y between Z and the ring C=O.
substituents: OH on the enol carbon of the dione ring (the ring carbon at the top of that ring)
the aroyl C(=O) on the dione ring carbon that carries the C=C double bond to the enol carbon
ring C=O adjacent to Y

(R7)w drawn on a bond that crosses the dione ring rather than terminating on one named ring atom: standard Markush notation for w substituents distributed over the ring, so no single ring position is assigned
'( )v' bracket spanning the ring segment between Z and the enol carbon, making the ring size variable
R2 at C2 of the benzene ring (top vertex, adjacent to the ipso carbon bearing the ketone)
L-R1 at C3 of the benzene ring (L drawn as a divalent linker between the ring and R1)
R3 at C4 of the benzene ring
R4 at C5 of the benzene ring (bottom vertex)
R5 at C6 of the benzene ring (adjacent to the ipso carbon on the other side)

drawings.notes: Schema 4 as printed. Two arrows: a horizontal solid arrow from Ia to Ib, and a vertical solid arrow running down from Ib to Ic. Both arrows are completely bare: no reagent, solvent, temperature or catalyst is written above or below either one, and both regions were inspected at high magnification to confirm this rather than assumed. Read as the invention's own route because the scheme sits in the run of numbered preparation schemes in this patent's description and its three structures are subtypes Ia, Ib and Ic of the patent's own general formula (I); no prior-art wording appears on this page. Nothing on this page states what converts Ia to Ib or Ib to Ic, so the transformations are recorded only as drawn. No SMILES is given for any of the three: every one is a Markush skeleton with variable ring size (v), a variable number of ring substituents (w) and undefined ring members Y and Z, so no complete atom-and-bond assignment exists to write down. Substituent numbering on the benzene ring is read off the drawing: the ipso carbon carries the ketone, R2 is the adjacent top vertex, then L-R1, R3, R4 and R5 running round the ring.

discrepancies.what: The scheme and the prose on this page describe different things, so no cross-check between them is possible on this page alone.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Ia converts to Ib, and Ib converts to Ic, with no reagents or conditions written on either arrow.
discrepancies.text_says: The only prose on the page is about the herbicidal activity of the formula (I) compounds against mono- and dicotyledonous weeds. It says nothing about Schema 4 or about any of Ia, Ib and Ic. Any text describing these transformations lies on the preceding or following pages.
